data.completion_memo: Implemented core-owned generation-fenced worker supervision with immutable snapshot handshakes, committed control admission, health state, stale generation rejection, and restart budgets. The worker exposes no host channel. cargo test -p aworkit-trusted-core passes.
data.description: Implement core-owned worker process generations, authenticated handshakes, health, restart budgets, cancellation, and complete process-tree cleanup. Wire the worker's sole IPC gateway to frozen snapshots, committed controls, proposals, checkpoints, and outcomes without creating a worker-to-host channel.
data.title: M04.5 — Supervise and integrate the workflow worker
